paragraphs: MIYO Health delivers integrated services for special education and mental health in schools. The company was founded in 2019 and operates in 20+ states. Its about page counts over 5,000 providers and 500,000+ sessions delivered.

Products listed on the home page include an IEP Platform for compliance, documentation, and student management. The MIYO Pathways suite adds MIYO Connect, MIYO Care, MIYO Insights, a Universal Screener, and MIYO SUD.

The site groups solutions for School Districts, Provider Networks, and State Agencies. Case studies name a rural Kansas school district and an IL school district that partnered with MIYO Health. Districts can buy a single provider or a package with providers, technology and wraparound support.

quote.text: One integrated ecosystem for the entire student wellness journey.
